name: How far in advance should I start planning a custom kitchen remodel?

mainEntity.name: How far in advance should I start planning a custom kitchen remodel?
mainEntity.text: How far in advance should I start planning a custom kitchen remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: Custom kitchen planning should begin well before the desired start date because the process includes design development, product selection, estimating, permitting, and fabrication. In Los Angeles, cabinet lead times and permit review can easily affect the start schedule, especially if the project includes custom millwork or structural changes. Starting early gives the homeowner more time to compare layouts, finalize appliance choices, and avoid rushed decisions that often cause delays later. It also creates time to confirm budgets and decide whether the project needs scope adjustments before construction begins. The safest approach is to begin planning as soon as the homeowner thinks the kitchen will be remodeled, even if the actual build is several months away. That lead time is especially valuable for luxury kitchens, because custom materials and specialty items often have longer ordering windows. Early planning also makes it easier to coordinate with the rest of a larger home renovation if the kitchen is not being done alone.
acceptedAnswer.description: Planning should start months before construction begins because design development, material selection, cabinet fabrication, and permitting all take time. Custom kitchens run more smoothly when long-lead items are chosen early and drawings are finalized before demolition.
